fields.System.Title: RET-406 — Notify the ERP for credit
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a finance team member, I want to be told the outcome of a return, so that the
customer is credited for what was genuinely returned in acceptable condition.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a completed disposition, then an event is published carrying the RMA, the
  • quantities, the grades, and the disposition outcomes.
  • - Given the sequencing, then the notification happens after disposition, not on
  • arrival — crediting on arrival refunds goods that turn out to be scrap.
  • - Given the event, then it goes through the outbox and is retried on failure.
  • - Given duplicate delivery, then the ERP is documented as required to deduplicate on
  • event_id.
  • - Given a partly dispositioned return, then the notification covers only the completed
  • portion.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | returns, platform |
| Tables | disposition, outbox |
| Risks | Credit raised before inspection ([doc 05 WF 9](../../../docs/05-workflows.md)); double-crediting ([doc 09 §3.4](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md)) |
| Tests | integration · event assertion |
